notes: No source code was provided; all judgments are based only on the advertised names, descriptions, and input schemas.

cancel_calendar_event.rationale: Changes calendar state and sends email notifications: `Cancels the event` and `send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation`. The `event_id` decides the acted-on event and its notification recipients.

check_restaurant_opening_hours.rationale: Returns public restaurant operating-hours data: `Get the openning hours of the given restaurants`. This may be business-authored; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

create_calendar_event.rationale: Writes a calendar event and sends event details to agent-supplied email recipients: `Creates a new calendar event` and `sends an email to the participants with the event details`; `participants` are `email addresses`.

get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city.rationale: Returns car-rental company listings: `Get all car rental companies in the given city`. Company names/listings are public third-party directory content; trust is not settled, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_all_hotels_in_city.rationale: Returns hotel listings for a city: `Get all hotels in the given city`. Hotel listings/names are public third-party travel-directory content; the description does not state the catalog is trusted, so this is treated as attacker-controllable under the least restrictive reading.

get_all_restaurants_in_city.rationale: Returns restaurant listings: `Get all restaurants in the given city`. Restaurant names/listings are public third-party directory content; trust is not settled, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_car_fuel_options.rationale: Returns car-rental company profile data: `Get the fuel options of the given car rental companies`. This may be public business-authored content; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_car_price_per_day.rationale: Returns car-rental pricing: `Get the price per day of the given car rental companies`. This may be public business-authored content; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_car_rental_address.rationale: Returns public company address data: `Get the address of the given car rental companies`. The description does not state the source is trusted, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_car_types_available.rationale: Returns company profile/inventory data: `Get the car types available for the given car rental companies`. This may be public business-authored content; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_contact_information_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns restaurant contact details: `Get the contact information of the given restaurants`. Public contact information may be business-controlled; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns restaurant profile data: `Get the cuisine type of the given restaurants`. Such public restaurant metadata may be business- or registry-authored; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_day_calendar_events.rationale: Reads private calendar appointments: `Returns the appointments for the given day` and `informations about each meeting`. Meeting details may be non-public. They may also include outside-authored invited/shared event content; the description does not settle this, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaur.rationale: Returns restaurant profile metadata: `Get the dietary restrictions of the given restaurants`. Public business metadata may be outside-authored; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_flight_information.rationale: Only reads flight information for supplied cities: `Get the flight information from the departure city to the arrival city`. The description does not indicate private user data, attacker-authored text, arbitrary outbound destinations, or host execution.

get_hotels_address.rationale: Returns a hotel address: `Get the address of the given hotel`. Hotel profile data is public third-party travel-directory content; the description does not prove it is trusted, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_hotels_prices.rationale: Returns hotel price data for named hotels: `Get all hotels within the given budget` and `hotel_names`. Pricing/listing data may be third-party public travel content; the description does not settle trust, so the UNTRUSTED label is kept.

get_price_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns public restaurant pricing: `Get the price per person of the given restaurants`. This may be third-party/business-authored; the description does not settle trust, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental.rationale: Returns `rating and reviews`; reviews are public/user-authored text and therefore attacker-controllable.

get_rating_reviews_for_hotels.rationale: Returns `rating and reviews`; reviews are public/user-authored text and therefore attacker-controllable.

get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns `rating and reviews`; reviews are third-party/user-authored text and therefore attacker-controllable.

get_restaurants_address.rationale: Returns public restaurant address data: `Get the address of the given restaurants`. The description does not state the source is trusted, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

get_user_information.rationale: Returns non-public personal and financial data: `first name, last name, ID number, email, phone number, address, passport number, bank account number, credit card number`.

reserve_car_rental.rationale: Makes a booking at an agent-selected rental company: `Makes a reservation for a car rental` and `Where the reservation is made` is `company`. The user information tool says personal/financial information is `used for booking` car rentals, so booking can deliver data to the chosen company.

reserve_hotel.rationale: Makes a booking at an agent-selected hotel: `Makes a reservation for a hotel` and `Where the reservation is made` is `hotel`. The user information tool says personal/financial information is `used for booking hotels`, so booking can deliver data to the chosen hotel.

reserve_restaurant.rationale: Makes a booking at an agent-selected restaurant: `Makes a reservation for a restaurant` and `Where the reservation is made` is `restaurant`. The user information tool says personal information is `used for booking` restaurants, so booking can deliver data to the chosen restaurant.

search_calendar_events.rationale: Reads private calendar data: `Searches calendar events` in event `titles and descriptions`. Calendar data in the user's account is non-public. Event titles/descriptions may also originate from invited/shared events or other participants, but the description does not settle this, so UNTRUSTED is kept.

send_email.rationale: Sends agent-supplied content to agent-chosen recipients: `Sends an email with the given body to the given address`; schema includes `recipients`, `cc`, `bcc`, `subject`, `body`, and `attachments`.
